review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the simp-relevant definitions: `pointCoordinate`, `pointLabel`, `pointLabel_add`, `pointCoordinate_add` and `endpointLabel_add`. I also grepped for other uses of the `simp only [endpointLabel_add,pointLabel]` idiom in the SimpleAmenable directory. The remaining theorems here are applications of existing lemmas with no simp interface of their own, so I found no loop, orientation or competing-rule problem. I did not run Lean, so I don't claim the proposed lemma compiles or changes simp behaviour in practice. The finding is an interface suggestion backed by the repeated idiom in four files.

findings.problem: The `pointLabel`/`pointCoordinate`/`endpointLabel` simp interface has no canonical lemma for the shape `endpointLabel (x + pointCoordinate z j)`. `pointLabel` is a plain def, defined as `endpointLabel (pointCoordinate z j)`, and it has simp lemmas only for `pointLabel_add` and `coordinateWindow_pointLabel`. Proofs therefore have to unfold the definition with `simp only [endpointLabel_add, pointLabel]`. After that unfolding the goal mixes `pointLabel z j` in the hypotheses with `endpointLabel (pointCoordinate z j)` in the result. This moves terms out of the `pointLabel` normal form that `pointLabel_add` and `coordinateWindow_pointLabel` target. The same unfolding idiom is copied in StarAtomLaw.lean (lines 110 and 114) and CoverUniformBridges.lean (lines 183 and 187).
findings.proposed_change: In LabelShiftedCharts.lean, next to `pointLabel`, add a simp lemma `endpointLabel_pointCoordinate (z) (j) : endpointLabel (pointCoordinate z j) = pointLabel z j := rfl`. This folds the expression back into `pointLabel` instead of unfolding `pointLabel`. Together with the existing `endpointLabel_add`, `simp only [endpointLabel_add, endpointLabel_pointCoordinate]` would rewrite `endpointLabel (l j + pointCoordinate z j)` to `endpointLabel (l j) + pointLabel z j`. If wanted, add a dedicated lemma `endpointLabel_add_pointCoordinate`. Then replace the four `simp only [endpointLabel_add,pointLabel]` calls with the folding lemma. The `omega` steps keep working because `pointLabel z j` stays an atom.
findings.benefit: Terms stay in the `pointLabel` normal form, so they can combine with `pointLabel_add` and `coordinateWindow_pointLabel`. The four proofs in three files no longer unfold a def to reach a rewrite. Readers see the shifted-label statement in the same vocabulary as the hypotheses `hL`/`hV` and the `fun j => pointLabel z j+p j` windows used elsewhere. Folding to `pointLabel` also rules out a `pointLabel` ↔ `endpointLabel (pointCoordinate ..)` mismatch that unfolding can produce when `simp` is applied to hypotheses.

evidence.excerpt: noncomputable def pointLabel (z : CutRing × CutRing) (j : Fin 2) : ℤ := endpointLabel (pointCoordinate z j)
